feature: Shopping for all decks v2 (handoff design_handoff_the99_all_decks_cart_v2; plan 2026-10-28-all-decks-cart-v2.md)
note: PR 8 rows: the chassis frame, search and sort in the three views that exist today. PR 4 rows: By card's row facts (the `+N` pill, an opened list, a cut lone name with `more`, a row with nothing owned); the `more` row needs a deck whose name is too wide for its cell on its own (the board's fixture is 43 characters; at 390 the need cell is about 180px). PR 5 rows: By deck's open group (its own column header with `This deck · also` on desktop, the `DECK` line on a phone, `also` naming only the other decks, a `+N` pill and an opened list); the groups start folded, so each row opens the first. PR 6 rows: By friend's panels (By friend's column header with `Spare` on desktop, the head's `N cards · N spares`, the row's need, spare and own facts, the Ask or its status above the tag, a folded panel, and on desktop the open header stuck to the list box top while its rows scroll); they need a friend with a spare of a selected line, and the status row a request already sent. The single-spare panel (`1 card · 1 spare`) and the spare key while the read is out are proved in `cart-by-friend.test.tsx`, since neither holds still on a live account. Later PRs add the Friend and Owned filters and the reading, empty and failed states. Needs a server with ALL_DECKS_CART_ENABLED=true and an account whose decks are missing cards (a pull:staging copy of Hugh's).
